jobs.occupation: Expert R&D Automation and Data Management (m/f/d) (Informationsmanager/in)
jobs.description: html Expert R&D Automation and Data Management (m/f/d)Become part of a vital chain and contribute to our common goal of making people’s lives better. Octapharma is one of the largest human protein manufacturers in the world, developing and producing medicines sourced from human plasma and human cell lines. We are a privately-owned company, where the warmth of family meets the scale of a global organisation.Octapharma Biopharmaceuticals GmbH with more than 200 employees is a subsidiary of the Octapharma group founded in 1997 and successfully expanding. Our core business is the development of recombinant proteins produced in human cell lines for therapeutic use in humans. We strive for effective treatments with an improved tolerability and convenience for our patients.Join us in shaping our vision to provide new health solutions advancing human life.We are looking for anExpert R&D Automation and Data Management (m/f/d)to join the Automation and Data Management unit within the Research and Development Department at Octapharma Biopharmaceuticals GmbH.The Automation and Data Management unit is responsible for the development, evaluation and long-term maintenance of automation- and data-driven solutions across R&D. The unit supports scientific projects by combining laboratory automation, data management, bioinformatics and scientific computing, and is involved in the work of multiple research units and virtually all projects within the department.The successful candidate will take on a challenging and versatile role with a strong focus on scientific computing, molecular modelling and high-performance computing (HPC). The position combines the application of computational methods to biological research questions with hands-on responsibility for the administration and strategic development of on-site Linux-based HPC infrastructure. Working closely with interdisciplinary research teams from all R&D units and Corporate IT, the candidate will ensure reliable and secure HPC operations while developing computational solutions to support scientific research. The role also includes contributions to internal data science and machine learning projects, with opportunities to develop expertise in new scientific and technical areas.Your main tasks and responsibilities- Development and application of molecular modelling approaches and molecular dynamics simulations to support scientific research, including protein characterization and developability studies- Administration, maintenance, optimization and strategic development of a Linux-based HPC infrastructure, including workload management and operational reliability- Development and maintenance of scripts and robust, reproducible, scalable workflows for scientific data processing, modelling and analysis, including testing and documentation- Contribution to internal data science and machine learning projects, including the evaluation and application of new computational approaches- Scientific and technical support of interdisciplinary research teams, translating research requirements into suitable computational solutions- Contribution to the integration and further development of data management, scientific computing and laboratory automation workflowsYour expertise and ideal skill set- PhD in Life Sciences with a strong focus on Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Biophysics or a related scientific discipline; postdoctoral experience is considered a plus. Candidates with an M.Sc. and extensive, highly relevant professional experience may also be considered- Practical experience in molecular modelling and molecular dynamics simulations of biological systems; hands-on experience with Molecular Operating Environment (MOE) is highly desirable- Strong programming skills in Python, particularly in scientific computing, data processing and analysis- Proven experience administering Linux-based HPC or cluster environments, including SLURM or comparable workload management systems, with a sound understanding of performance optimization and the ability to troubleshoot independently- Experience in planning, extending or optimizing scientific computing infrastructure is considered a plus- Experience in laboratory automation or the integration of automated laboratory systems with data processing workflows is considered a plus- Interest in machine learning and willingness to explore new scientific and technical topics- Experience with electronic laboratory management systems, such as ELN, LIMS or sample management solutions (e.g. Benchling or comparable platforms), is considered a plus- Practical experience with version control systems and workflow automation (CI/CD); familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) is considered a plus- Independent and structured working style, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and excellent communication and collaboration skills in an interdisciplinary environment- Fluent English skills; a good command of German is considered a plusThrive with us- A permanent position in full-time (40 hrs./week) in a dynamically growing company- A modern, "state of the art" working environment- Flexible working hours- Regular opportunities for further training- 30 days vacation- Own company restaurant with subsidies- Free drinks such as coffee, tea and water- Job ticket or parking space for bicycle or car- An international team in an international corporate environment- A collegial environment with many opportunities for activitiesAbout OctapharmaOctapharma is one of the largest human protein manufacturers in the world, developing and producing human proteins from human plasma and human cell lines. jobs.employer_name: Technische Universität München (TUM),  Forschungs-Neutronenquelle Heinz Maier-Leibnitz ...
jobs.description: Technical University Munich operates the high flux Neutron Source Heinz Maier-Leibnitz (FRM II) located at the scientific campus in Garching, Germany. The neutron source itself, its research instruments as well as the irradiation facilities provide unique possibilities for the scientific and industrial use of neutron beams.TOFTOF is a neutron time-of-flight chopper spectrometer to study dynamic processes in hard and soft condensed matter. The main areas of application are from materials science, soft matter, biological or magnetic systems. After years of successful operation, the instrument will receive a significant technical upgrade in the coming years.For the further development and the operation of the instrument TOFTOF we invite applications for a full-time (40 h/week) scientist position (m/f/d) asInstrument Scientist Toftof (m/f/d) You will be responsible for the scientific oversight of the technical upgrade of the instrument TOFTOF and attend to its technical realisation.Your tasks include:Scientific lead of TOFTOF’s further developments, i.e. of the neutron transport and chopper system. Conceptual design and future development of the secondary spectrometer, including the neutron detectors. Demonstration of its performance for the intended scientific applications.Project lead for the technical realisation of the upgrade work packages at TOFTOFExperimental tests of instrument critical components to validate performanceMethod development in the area of neutron spectroscopyOperation of the instrument and scientific and technical support in user operationPursuit of own scientific projects using neutron spectroscopy methodsYour responsibility is focused on the instrument TOFTOF. In future, your tasks might include further instrumentation projects.PhD in physics, chemistry, materials science, or a related field.Strong background in neutron spectroscopy and hands-on experience with experimental techniques and instrumentation. Experience with polarized neutrons are an asset.Demonstrated ability to conduct instrumentation projects and operate complex scientific setups.Knowledge of scientific programming and data analysis (e.g. Python, C++, MATLAB) is required, experience with ray tracing simulation packages, e.g. McStas, are beneficial.Self-motivated and independent working style combined with the ability to work in an international and interdisciplinary team.Demonstrated ability to conduct independent scientific research and motivation to develop an own scientific research profilePersuasive communication skills and ability to work in a team in an international environment are mandatory. Good oral and written English skills are required, German language skills are an asset.For further information about the position, please contact Wiebke Lohstroh, E-Mail: wiebke.lohstroh@frm2.tum.deThe high safety standard of our facility requires the reliability of the employees according to German nuclear law. Appropriate reliability checks have to be performed for all employees.We offer flexible working hours, 30 days' vacation per year and a company pension plan (VBL). As an employee of FRM II, you can benefit from many other TUM offers, such asTUM's health offersUniversity sportsTUM's internal continuing education and training opportunitiesTUM childcare (subject to availability)Very good accessibility by public transportThe position is remunerated according to TV-L and limited to 3 years. The position is suitable for severely disabled people. Severely disabled applicants will be given preference if they otherwise have essentially the same suitability, qualifications and professional performance. TUM aims to increase the proportion of women. Applications from women are therefore expressly welcomed.

In this role, you will be responsible for excellent project performance and serve as the enabler to deliver automotive quality inspection, containment, rework, and customer support activities.KEY RESPONSIBILITIES- Ensure compliance with customer site instructions, work instructions, HSE, and 5S requirements.- Set up and enable inspection, sorting, containment, and rework activities.- Set up and maintain accurate documentation and traceability.- Use Aktrion digital reporting tools and customer systems to monitor KPIs and prepare reports.- Coordinate customer's technical and commercial targets and requirements.- Coordinate projects, personnel, and daily operations.- Communicate with customer representatives, monitor KPIs, and prepare reports.- Coach and develop team members on site.YOUR PROFILE- Languages: Very good English mandatory; German and/or Polish are an advantage.- Automotive quality knowledge and experience.- Attention to detail and ability to work under pressure.- Experience managing kick-offs, meetings, deadlines, and customer feedback.- Digital literacy: MS Office (Excel, Teams, Outlook), computer literacy, customer portals, basic statistical analysis.- Willingness to work in shifts.PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS- ISO 9001, 3S/5S, and Lean awareness.- Valid driving license.- First Aid certificate, Forklift license (preferred), High Voltage Level 1–3 (depending on project).WHAT WE OFFER- Competitive salary.- 28 days of paid vacation per year.- Company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge).- Great working atmosphere, mutual support, and team spirit.- Company laptop and mobile phone.- Ongoing training and career development.- Opportunity to join a growing international automotive business.APPLICATION- Location: Ragow, Germany- Send your application to: jobs.de@aktrion.comErgänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Expertenkenntnisse: Projektmanagement
